plotaroute.assessment: The public help documents manual download. Terms restrict copying/reproduction/distribution except personal non-commercial use without express permission. Applicability to this project's automated research/export is not established; no export was attempted.

viewgpx.assessment: The product explicitly describes public shared-file downloads without an account. Both organizer-linked pages returned HTML. A clean temporary Chrome session exposed only the page footer and no usable download control or explicit download URL. No embedded XML was counted as a downloaded GPX.
viewgpx.browser_method: Fresh temporary profile, no login; initial sandbox launch failed, approved unsandboxed launch worked. Domain-limited browser resource loading may have affected client rendering; this is not evidence that the website's export is broken.

google_drive.assessment: Four exact file links were found on organizer pages. Raw bytes were retrieved through the connected Drive service and materialized within the 12 MiB cap. Origin HTTP/DNS/redirect details are not exposed by the connector; anonymous access was not independently verified.
